name: Bot: daily report and Telegram commands

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().filter((i) => i.json.cmd === '/backup').map((i) => ({ json: { requestedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }));
return [{ json: { text: 'Backup started. The encrypted file and the Drive link arrive here in about a minute.' } }];

const known = ['/backup', '/status', '/report', '/health', '/sendwrap'];
return $input.all().filter((i) => !known.includes(i.json.cmd)).map(() => ({ json: { text: [
  'Paisa Reality bot. Commands:',
  '/status    site health, last backup, price freshness and today\'s numbers',
  '/health    what on the site needs updating: prices, rates, deadlines, official links',
  '/sendwrap  email this week\'s price post to subscribers (once)',
  '/backup    make a full backup now and send it here and to Google Drive',
  '/help      this list',
  '',
  'You also get: site-down and recovery alerts, a report every morning at 9, the data health report at 8:40, official links that break or change, the weekly price post on Sunday evening, new contact messages and sign-ups, and an alert if any automation fails.',
].join('\n') } }));

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM users)::int AS users,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')::int AS users_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM subscribers WHERE status = 'active')::int AS subscribers,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM subscribers WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')::int AS subscribers_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM price_alerts WHERE active)::int AS active_alerts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM contact_messages WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')::int AS messages_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM contact_messages WHERE NOT is_read)::int AS messages_unread,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM blog_posts WHERE is_published)::int AS articles,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM schemes WHERE is_active)::int AS schemes,
  (SELECT max(created_at) FROM gold_prices) AS gold_written_at,
  (SELECT max(price_date) FROM gold_prices)::text AS gold_date,
  (SELECT min(data_as_of) FROM fuel_prices WHERE price_date = (SELECT max(price_date) FROM fuel_prices))::text AS fuel_as_of,
  (SELECT min(data_as_of) FROM lpg_prices WHERE price_date = (SELECT max(price_date) FROM lpg_prices))::text AS lpg_as_of
